1.finding: 6,42,80,246 shares of Rs 5 plus 6.75 lakh vested options (diluted 6,49,55,246). FY26 EPS 41.26 basic / 40.36 diluted; FY23 EPS 84.99 was on fewer shares before CCD conversion in FY24-25 (DRHP p. 19).

2.finding: Operating cash flow Rs -13.27 / -120.17 / +235.24 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 175.16 / 229.78 / 265.20 cr (cumulative 15%). Carry ('Variable Additional Return') is booked at fair value before it is received: unrealised carry Rs 94.57 / 190.73 / 290.47 cr was recognised, while realised carry of Rs 430.69 cr (FY26) and Rs 338.10 cr (Q1 FY27) came in as cash. FY26-Q1 FY27 operating cash flow Rs 365.6 cr against PAT Rs 345.9 cr.

3.finding: Current tax only Rs 3.94 cr on FY26 PBT Rs 338.64 cr, deferred tax Rs 69.50 cr: tax on unrealised carry and fair-value gains is deferred until realisation (deferred tax liability Rs 145.06 cr at Jun-26). In Q1 FY27, as carry was realised, current tax was Rs 56.41 cr with a Rs 31.31 cr deferred-tax reversal. Tax follows cash, as expected.

4.finding: Part of the Edelweiss group: in FY25 it bought asset-management rights (Rs 21.32 cr), sponsor units and carry rights from group companies; group term loans have been repaid; a dividend of Rs 205.70 cr (78% of FY26 PAT) was paid to the group in FY26 before the IPO. Executive Chairman Rashesh Shah also chairs EFSL.

5.finding: Pure offer for sale by Edelweiss Securities and Investments; the company receives nothing.

7.finding: No goodwill; intangibles Rs 14.14 cr are asset-management rights bought from a group company in FY25, being amortised.

8.finding: 5,398 client relationships; 51.67% of AUM from institutions; 73% of AUM from repeat clients. No single-client dependence disclosed.

9.finding: Company contingent liability Rs 0.23 cr. Claims against the promoters (mainly tax, Rs 214.93 cr) sit at the Edelweiss group level.

6.finding: Distribution costs of raising funds are capitalised and amortised over fund tenure; unamortised balance Rs 667.94 cr at Jun-26 (58% of net worth), up Rs 167.03 cr in FY26. Permitted by Ind AS and matched to fees, but reported profit is higher than on a pay-as-you-go basis while fund-raising grows (adjusted P/E in part 5).

R3.finding: No fresh issue, so no monitoring agency.

R6.finding: Four BRLMs (Axis, Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, Nuvama); Motilal Oswal is in the desk database, others not compiled. Nuvama is also a listed peer.

rationale.g1: Revenue from operations Rs 492.58 / 670.26 / 869.54 cr FY24-26 (+36%, +30%); Q1 FY27 Rs 275.53 cr vs Rs 190.81 cr (+44%) (Add. p. 107). Fee-paying AUM Rs 30,398 -> 33,833 -> 44,710 cr, Rs 48,623 cr at Jun-26 (Add. p. 7). Management fees grew 20% and 21% in FY25-26; carry is lumpier. Neutral 20% then easing to 12% (fees plus a normal level of carry); Bear 7-8% (fees only, weak carry); Bull 28% then 14%.
rationale.m: Operating EBITDA (PBT + finance cost + D&A - other income, before the Rs 9.88 cr labour-code charge) Rs 162.85 / 228.37 / 323.27 cr = 33.1% / 34.1% / 37.2% of revenue from operations FY24-26; Q1 FY27 21.6% as employee cost doubled (Add. p. 107). Neutral 35%; Bear 30%; Bull 38%.
rationale.nwc: Trade receivables less payables 6.0% of FY26 revenue (Add. p. 106); asset-light. Neutral 5%.
rationale.roic: Asset-light fee business: ROE 25.97% on a book that includes Rs 928 cr of fund investments. Terminal ROIC on operating capital 40% (Neutral).
rationale.capex: Prepaid distribution costs are kept out of working capital because their amortisation is already in operating costs; with them in working capital (cash basis), the Neutral DCF is about Rs 550 instead of Rs 619. Capex is minimal (Rs 1.13 cr in FY26). Net debt is negative: borrowings Rs 399.20 cr + leases Rs 23.32 cr - cash and bank Rs 247.32 cr - investments Rs 927.77 cr (sponsor and GP commitments, current and non-current) at Jun-26 = Rs -752.58 cr. Investment income is excluded from EBITDA, so the investments are added at book value. Accrued carry in other non-current assets (Rs 564.90 cr) is not added: a conservative choice.

kpi._cite: Operating EBITDA, our computation from the restated P&L (Add. p. 107): PBT + finance cost + D&A - other income, FY26 before the Rs 9.88 cr statutory labour-code charge. The issuer reports no EBITDA KPI.

earnings_quality._note: Pre-tax Rs crore by year [FY24, FY25, FY26]; negative reduces profit, positive raises it.

adjustments.item: Upfront selling and distribution costs of fund-raising capitalised as prepaid expenses (net increase in the year)
adjustments.reason: Upfront and trail fees paid to distributors for raising funds are amortised over each fund's tenure; the unamortised balance (prepaid expenses, current + non-current) rose from Rs 255.01 cr (FY23) to Rs 384.57 / 471.52 / 638.55 cr (FY24-26) and Rs 667.94 cr at Jun-26. Ind AS permits capitalising incremental costs of obtaining a contract and this matches the fee stream, but expensing them as paid would cut FY26 pre-tax profit by Rs 167.03 cr. Flag: timing, not a cash leak - the cost is real and is being recognised over time.

adjustments.item: One-off charge for the new Labour Codes (exceptional item)
adjustments.reason: Statutory impact of the new Labour Codes, Rs 9.88 cr, shown as an exceptional item in FY26; one-off, so added back.

adjustments.item: Tax credit for earlier years (grossed up to pre-tax)
adjustments.reason: Excess tax of earlier years written back: Rs 13.70 cr in FY24, Rs 0.53 cr in FY25, Rs 0.64 cr in FY26 (post-tax). Shown grossed up so the post-tax effect matches.

adjustments.item: Unrealised carry (Variable Additional Return booked at fair value)
adjustments.reason: Carry is recognised as the fund NAV crosses its hurdle, before it is paid; it is a normal accounting policy and was realised in cash at Rs 430.69 cr in FY26. Excluding it gives a fee-plus-investment-income view of the P/E. For information.

adjustments.item: GP income: interest and fair-value gains on the company's own fund investments
adjustments.reason: Returns on the company's sponsor and co-investment commitments, reported in other income. Recurring for an alternatives manager but market-linked. For information.
